test_fixed_point_algorithm: test the fixed_point.FixedPoint algorithm by running iterations and verifying Nash Conv convergence on crowd_modelling game
test_softmax_policy: test the fixed_point.FixedPoint algorithm with a softmax temperature parameter to produce a regularized policy
run_fixed_point_iteration: run fixed_point.FixedPoint iterations on a pyspiel MFG game to converge to a fixed point policy
compute_nash_conv: compute the nash_conv metric using nash_conv.NashConv to evaluate how close a policy is to Nash equilibrium
get_fixed_point_policy: get the converged policy from a fixed_point.FixedPoint instance after running iterations
